criteria.quote: Pikachu raises its tail. Lightning sometimes strikes it.
criteria.revision: Make the contrast more immediate and specific: "Pikachu raises its tail to check its surroundings—but the Pokédex says lightning sometimes strikes it in that exact pose."

criteria.quote: Pikachu raises its tail to check its surroundings.
criteria.revision: Replace the generic caption "A RAISED TAIL HELPS IT MONITOR AROUND IT" with the concrete wording "THE TAIL IS RAISED TO CHECK ITS SURROUNDINGS."

criteria.quote: Why does Pikachu raise a tail that lightning sometimes strikes?
criteria.revision: Turn the open loop into a clearer tradeoff grounded in the entries: "Why use a pose for checking its surroundings if lightning sometimes strikes the tail in that pose?"

criteria.quote: Several Pikachu can build electricity and cause lightning storms.
criteria.revision: Place this after the first tail-strike setup and frame it as a widening of the evidence: "The danger also scales beyond one Pikachu: several can build electricity and cause lightning storms."

criteria.quote: It says lightning sometimes strikes the tail in this pose.
criteria.revision: Delay this reveal until after the purpose of the pose. Replace the opening narration with "Pikachu raises its tail for a reason. Another Pokédex entry records what can happen in that pose," then reveal the lightning strike here.

criteria.quote: Lightning sometimes strikes it.; The tail is sometimes struck by lightning in this pose.; It says lightning sometimes strikes the tail in this pose.
criteria.revision: Remove the repeated lightning scenes and give each remaining scene a distinct fact: purpose of the raised tail, the group lightning-storm entry, then the specific reveal that lightning sometimes strikes the tail in that pose.

criteria.quote: Pikachu raises its tail to check its surroundings, but that exact pose is sometimes when lightning strikes it.
criteria.revision: Make the ending resolve the contradiction rather than simply restate it: "The raised tail has a documented purpose—checking its surroundings—and a documented cost: lightning sometimes strikes it in that pose."

criteria.quote: Raise it to look around, or keep it down?
criteria.revision: Ask the evidence-based tradeoff directly: "If the raised tail helps Pikachu check its surroundings, but lightning sometimes strikes it in that pose, is the lookout worth the risk?"
